#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int T = 1;
    const long long MOD = 1000000007;

    for (int _ = 0; _ < T; ++_) {
        int n, m;
        cin >> n >> m;
        vector<int> arr(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            arr[i] = (long long)m * i % n;
        }

        if (m == 0) {
            long long result = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                result = (result * i) % MOD;
            }
            result = pow(n, n - 1, MOD);
            cout << result << "\n";
            continue;
        }

        vector<bool> visited(n, false);
        vector<int> count_cycles(n, 0);
        long long total_result = 1;

        for (int start_point = 0; start_point < n; ++start_point) {
            if (visited[start_point]) continue;
            int length = 0;
            int current = start_point;
            while (!visited[current]) {
                visited[current] = true;
                current = arr[current];
                ++length;
            }
            count_cycles[length]++;
        }

        for (int size = 1; size < n; ++size) {
            if (count_cycles[size] != 0) {
                long long total = size * count_cycles[size];
                if (size > 1) total += count_cycles[1];
                long long pow_result = 1;
                long long base = total % MOD;
                long long exp = count_cycles[size];
                long long b = base;
                long long e = exp;
                while (e > 0) {
                    if (e & 1) pow_result = (pow_result * b) % MOD;
                    b = (b * b) % MOD;
                    e >>= 1;
                }
                total_result = (total_result * pow_result) % MOD;
            }
        }

        cout << total_result << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
